name: What is the typical process for adding a new bathroom to my home?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for adding a new bathroom to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for a bathroom addition begins with a comprehensive design consultation to understand your vision and assess your home's structure. We then develop detailed CAD-supported layouts and manage all necessary permitting coordination. Following design finalization and permits, our team executes the construction, including structural integration, plumbing, electrical, and finish work, ensuring a seamless tie-in with your existing home. AKN Design Group provides a single point of coordination, guiding you through each stage from concept to final walkthrough, simplifying a complex renovation. Understanding this structured process helps homeowners anticipate each phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process for a bathroom addition involves design consultation, permitting, structural integration, and finish work, all managed by our design-build team.
